headline: Moody's upgrades Vietnam's sovereign credit rating to Ba1
summary: Moody's has upgraded Vietnam's sovereign credit rating from Ba2 to Ba1, placing the country one notch below investment grade.
why: Sovereign credit ratings influence the cost of borrowing for a country and its domestic companies, reflecting the perceived stability of the national economy.

impacts.name: Vietnam
impacts.why: A credit rating upgrade lowers the cost of government and corporate debt issuance.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Credit rating upgrades typically lead to increased investor confidence and lower yields on government bonds as the risk of default is perceived to have decreased.
